mihrabli.name: Mihrablı
mihrabli.note: Single niche pointing to the qibla; a kandil hangs from the apex or a tree of life rises from the base. Directional.

cift-mihrab.name: Çift mihrab
cift-mihrab.note: Two facing arches mirrored across the horizontal centre, an anchor in each. Erzurum.

bacali.name: Bacalı
bacali.note: Niches stacked vertically, all pointing up; each a small arch, a field and an anchor. Sivrihisar.

saf.name: Saf
saf.note: Vertical walls divide the field into compartments side by side, each capped by an apex and holding an anchor. Communal prayer kilim; Yüncü, Van.

bandli.name: Bandlı
bandli.note: Three to nine horizontal bands, each one motif repeated across; plain strips between; palette may shift band to band. Gaziantep, Sivas.

tumzemin.name: Tüm zemin
tumzemin.note: One motif tiled on a half-drop lattice; orientation and colour alternate per row; no focal point. Konya elibelinde grids.

khesti.name: Khesti
khesti.note: The field split into compartments on a brick grid, each holding one motif; the row-to-row offset is the rhythm. Konya panelled kilims.

madalyonlu.name: Madalyonlu
madalyonlu.note: A diamond medallion on an open field, its anchor a stepped göbek; one or three stacked; corners often carry quarter-medallions. Uşak, Kars.

bos-gobek.name: Boş göbek
bos-gobek.note: Centre deliberately sparse — one open medallion outline on plain ground; two end panels packed with diamonds. The negative space is the point. Fethiye.

aynali.name: Aynalı
aynali.note: The field split by a central axis; the top panel is designed and the bottom is its mirror. Aydın, Yüncü.
